errors.evidence: The chart has two Y-axes. The description incorrectly identifies a single Y-axis, labels it with a series name instead of an axis label, and misrepresents the scale and range by conflating the two different axes (left axis 0-2200, right axis 0-1000).
The Y-axes are not explicitly labeled with units. While "points" is the conventional unit for stock indices, the description should only include information visually present on the chart.
